_comment: DATA-0B-1 intake record. NOT a source_snapshot DB row (no database exists yet) — this is the repo-committed provenance record for the ONE bulk file this dispatch handles, in the shape the future source_snapshot.payload/source_uri/ingestion_run fields (db/data0/0001_generic_substrate.sql, 0A-r2) are designed to hold once real ingestion exists. NO IMPORT has happened. This file records intake only.

artifact.copy_method: copy, not move — original left untouched at original_path

source_version_note: Confirmed directly from the archive's own contents, not assumed: the zip contains exactly one file, named `2026-08-15.sql` (3633.8MB uncompressed, the plain-text MySQL dump). GCD's own docs state a bi-weekly regeneration cadence; this filename is that cadence's own version stamp.
rights_note: GCD metadata is CC BY-SA 4.0; cover images are explicitly excluded from that license per GCD's own docs (confirmed during the DATA-0 pre-flight) — this intake handles the metadata dump only, no image extraction performed or planned. The ShareAlike scope question (does a derivative catalog DB trigger the same-license obligation) remains open, pending counsel — see docs/DATA-0-ARCHITECTURE.md §9. This intake record exists regardless of that answer; it does not constitute ingestion.

ingestion_run.status_note: Intake + schema recon complete (checksum, copy, extract, stream-parse for structure). No rows imported. No database exists yet. Import (0B-2) is a separate, ungreenlit step. Full findings: docs/DATA-0B-1-SCHEMA-RECON.md.

schema_recon.table_count_correction: 78 — see staging_run_0b2 below. The recon's regex scan missed django_content_type (a standard Django-framework table, unrelated to GCD's own domain schema), confirmed present in the raw dump via direct grep. This field's 77 is retained as the historical structural-recon figure, not corrected in place.
schema_recon.gcd_issue_estimate_note: SUPERSEDED, not corrected — see gcd_issue_exact_rows below. At the time this was written (DATA-0B-1) it looked like the corrected planning number relative to the brief's own working figure of 2.2M; DATA-0B-2's real SELECT COUNT(*) later showed this estimate itself undercounted by +87.4%. Retained verbatim as the historical DATA-0B-1 record, not rewritten.
schema_recon.gcd_issue_exact_note: DATA-0B-2 (2026-08-21): the ESTIMATE above was itself off by +87.4% — the largest correction of the 8 headline tables. 2,608,777 is a real SELECT COUNT(*), not an estimate. See docs/DATA-0B-2-STAGING.md.
schema_recon.charset_note: Real mismatch, load-bearing per GK-143 — see report's 'Anything surprising' section. Confirmed non-corrupting for this class of character in DATA-0B-2's own real-data charset round-trip check (René Goscinny, é intact) — see staging_run_0b2 below.

staging_run_0b2.status_note: Stage 1 only (local MySQL staging) — the full raw dump loaded into a local-only Docker MySQL 8.0.46 instance, exact per-table row counts obtained via real SELECT COUNT(*). Stage 2 (transform into source_snapshot/claim/external_map) remains a separate, ungreenlit step, additionally blocked on the CC BY-SA rights question (docs/DATA-0-ARCHITECTURE.md §9). No Neon connection at any point. No production/runtime code touched.
staging_run_0b2.attempts_note: Attempts 1-3 discarded (host-shell-detach kill at 6 tables; a deadlock-collision ambiguity around ~52 tables; a clean run killed by an external process, not MySQL, at 68/77 tables) — each followed by a full docker compose down -v wipe before retrying, never a resume. Attempt 4 (detached-in-container, docker exec -d) succeeded: exit code 0, genuinely persisted by the wrapper script, not assumed.
staging_run_0b2.neon_fit_note: Local-only by design, per docs/DATA-0-ARCHITECTURE.md §8's pre-existing decision — this 7.55GB figure confirms (>15x the 0.5GB Neon free-tier cap) rather than newly reveals that raw GCD data was never meant to enter Neon. What eventually reaches Neon is a much smaller, transformed comic_*/external_map/claim subset — a stage-2 question, not addressed here.
